page.notes: The Greek sentence (lines 18–19) is read with doubt in several words, marked [?]. The whole Greek passage should be checked against the scan. A stray full stop stands at the start of the line "obire negaverit" after "exorta", kept as printed. The space between "causam" and "Bonifacio" is missing in the print ("caufamBonifa-"). The paragraph break before "Et Hottingerus" is inferred from the short line end, not from an indent. "Igna-" is the catchword, with hyphen as printed.
